prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear quarter panel and bumper cover show the main damage, and the pattern fits the side-swipe impact as reported. The left rear door shows a crease that runs toward the wheel arch, which is consistent with the same contact. Labor hours appear a little high for this scope, so the line items need a second look before approval. Two similar charges posted on the same day are under review with the shop. No prior damage to this vehicle is known. Proceed with parts ordering once the labor and charge questions are settled.
